svg.title: Lunabot 2027 - software roadmap
svg.text: Lunabot — the software road to Lunabotics 2027
Everything the software has to reach between today and competition week. Read it left to right; an arrow means the thing it points at cannot start until the thing behind it is done.
Branch develop-2027 as of 10 August 2026 · the stack builds and drives on mock hardware; Isaac has never been run and no rover has ever followed a path.
built, but known to be provisional
a proof point -- nothing behind it is real work until it clears
an artifact that leaves the team
somebody else has to hand it to us

svg.text: The three that decide the season

1. Isaac has never run. Until probe_isaac_api.sh clears, every simulation task behind it is a guess. 2. The compute choice gates cuVSLAM, and cuVSLAM is the only SLAM path with a GPU story. 3. There is no mission layer at all — lunabot_mission is a package that does not exist yet, and autonomy is where the points are.

The in-repo work queue is every PLACEHOLDER, VERIFY and TODO(2027) marker — 33 files carry one today. Milestone dates are the published NASA Lunabotics 2027 schedule; competition week is May 2027 at the Center for Space Education, KSC Visitor Complex, exact dates not yet released.
Confirm all of it against the guidebook when it lands on 3 September 2026 — the arena, the obstacle spec and the autonomy scoring tiers are placeholders until then.
